name: Lack of transparency and explainability
description: AI systems can be difficult to understand and interpret, making it challenging to understand how and why decisions are being made. Can lead to mistrust, errors, or legal issues.

name: Overreliance on AI
description: AI systems are not infallible and may have limitations or flaws. Overreliance could result in complacency, reduced human skills, or missed threats.

name: Bias and discrimination
description: AI systems may reflect or amplify biases of their data, algorithms, or developers, producing unfair or inaccurate outcomes for certain groups.

name: Vulnerability to attacks
description: AI systems may be targeted by malicious actors seeking to compromise, manipulate, or sabotage them via Adversarial ML attacks, potentially causing data breaches, misinformation, or system damage.

name: Lack of human oversight
description: AI systems may operate autonomously or with minimal human intervention, risking ethical, legal, or social issues if the system does not align with human values, norms, or regulations.

name: Privacy concerns
description: AI systems may collect and process vast amounts of sensitive or personal data, risking mishandling through intentional breaches or accidental leaks.

name: Misuse of artificial intelligence
description: AI systems may be used for malicious purposes by adversaries exploiting target-system vulnerabilities -- cyberattacks, cyberespionage, sabotage, or cyberwarfare.

name: Assessment difficulties
description: Difficulty in assessing AI system effectiveness and ensuring correct behavior, in terms of both threat coverage and rehearsal vs. actual attack conditions.
